In [[138 ABY]], during the final stages of the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], a '''skirmish''' took place on [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. [[Darth Talon]] of the [[One Sith]] briefly fought the crew of the [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']], but fled after informing them of a gift she had left aboard the [[Helot-class medium space transport|ship]]&mdash;[[Imperial Knight]] [[Antares Draco]], [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|frozen]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]. Draco had been [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] into revealing the location of the [[New Jedi Order]]'s [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]] to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]] delivered Draco to ''Mynock'' [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Cade Skywalker]] so that Krayt's enemies in the [[Alliance (Second Imperial Civil War)|Alliance]] would rush to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] aid in defending the Temple, thus allowing him to crush them all in one swift stroke with his secret [[Darth Krayt's Sith trooper|Sith trooper]] [[Army/Legends|army]].
